scientific_intent.scientific_task: Copy opaque integer payloads using a fixed per-thread vector width.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Identity mapping on a 1048576-element Int32 array.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Flat aligned payload array; no scientific spatial topology.
invariants: Bit-exact copied payloads and preserved element order.
accuracy_requirements: Exact full Int32 output equality, nonzero signed fixture.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Integer indexing, alignment and tail handling determine correctness; no floating-point arithmetic.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Aligned Int32 vector-width4 case, ten repeats; other dtypes, widths and unaligned tails unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Memory movement microbenchmark, without a source-evidenced domain science application.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Native source uses aligned vector assignments but actual emitted SIMD memory instructions need code inspection, not source-only assumptions.
scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
